Internal helper: open a style's file, for jstyle(open = TRUE)

Source: R/tables.R
dot-jst_style_open_file.Rd

The style named – or the session's, joptions(style = ), when none is – found as jstyle() finds it and handed to the editor, then checked: a file holding a value jstats cannot use stops on that line with the file already open, so it can be put right (Session 409). A built-in style has no file, and the stop gives the line that saves a copy and opens it. The session test and the opener are arguments, so a battery can stand in for both and open nothing, as for jtable()'s open =.

Usage

.jst_style_open_file(
  style,
  cl = NULL,
  mc = NULL,
  ask = interactive(),
  edit = utils::file.edit
)

Arguments

style

The style argument as given.

cl, mc

The call, for the line a near miss offers.

ask

Logical; whether the session is interactive.

edit

The function that opens the file.

Value

The style, resolved.
